file_change.purpose: Define the minimum durable machine-readable Conformance evidence used by Core acceptance decisions.
implementation: Define Draft 2020-12 JSON schema for stable report identity, subject type and identity, PASS/FAIL disposition, evidence references, and deterministic mechanical findings.
Each finding records a machine-oriented code, diagnostic message, and optional repository-relative path.
Forbid fields that purport to create or amend normative semantics; Conformance evidence remains mechanical and non-authoritative.
Do not require deferred mature check registries or independent exact-revision fields when evidence references establish the mechanically evaluated subject.
